explanation: The Almighty Creator who, according to Genesis, created the heavens, the earth, and all life.
The term used to describe God's act of bringing the universe and everything in it into existence.
False gods or idols that people worship instead of the true God.
The highest place where God dwells and reigns, often associated with the spiritual realm and divine presence.
The physical world and planet we live on, created by God as a place for humans to dwell and exercise their stewardship.
A feeling of security and faith in God, that He will fulfill His promises and care for His people.
To ask for divine protection, prosperity, and happiness for someone or something; also an acknowledgment of God's grace and favor.
A title often used for God in the Bible, denoting His authority and sovereignty over all creation.
